## Introduction

**Goal:** Evaluate the compute efficiency of different models over different
sample sizes.

**Data:** For model evaluation, data are simulated according to the generative
model.

**Method:** Models are timed during training.

## R Preamble

```{r}
#| label: library
library(parallel)
library(svglite)
```

```{r}
#| label: source-functions
#| code-fold: true
#| output: false
fns <- c(
  "constants.R",
  "dataframe-helpers.R",
  "plot-helpers.R",
  "plot-theme.R"
)

lapply(file.path("R", fns), source, verbose = FALSE)
```

**Constants**

```{r}
#| label: constants

#| eval: false
```

## Data

```{r}
#| label: intcal20
intcal20 <- structure(
  read.csv("data/intcal20.csv"),
  class = c("Calibration", "data.frame"),
  curve = "IntCal20"
)

intcal20 <- transform(intcal20, f14c_mu = exp(-c14_age / LIBBY))
intcal20 <- transform(intcal20, f14c_sigma = f14c_mu * c14_error / LIBBY)
```

## Timing

```{r}
#| label: model-timing
#| output: false
n_samples <- rep(seq(500, 5000, by = 500), each = 28)
n_iter <- length(n_samples)

# set up clusters
clusters <- makeCluster(14)

fns <- c(
  "bgmm.R",
  "calibrate.R",
  "ckde.R",
  "constants.R",
  "dataframe-helpers.R",
  "dpmm.R",
  "metrics.R",
  "mixture-helpers.R",
  "netc14.R",
  "sample-dates.R",
  "simulate-chronology.R",
  "spd.R"
)

clusterExport(
  clusters,
  varlist = c("fns", "intcal20", "n_samples"),
  envir = environment()
)

clusterEvalQ(clusters, {
  library(carbondate)
  library(torch)
  torch_set_num_threads(1)
  lapply(file.path("R", fns), source)
})

# run simulations in parallel
timing_results <- parLapply(clusters, seq_len(n_iter), \(i) {
  set.seed(STARGATE + i)

  # scenario
  n_years <- 3000
  n_clusters <- 6
  start <- sample(seq(100, 49500 - n_years), 1)
  end <- start + n_years - 1

  # simulate chronology, draw samples, and calibrate
  chronology <- simulate_chronology(start, end, n_clusters)
  samples <- sample_dates(chronology, n_samples[i], intcal20)
  calibrated_dates <- calibrate(samples, intcal20)

  # training
  models <- list(
    ckde(calibrated_dates),
    bgmm(calibrated_dates),
    dpmm(samples),
    netc(calibrated_dates),
    spd(calibrated_dates)
  )

  # collect and return
  elapsed <- sapply(models, attr, which = "elapsed")

  data.frame(
    iter = i,
    model = c("CKDE", "BGMM", "DPMM", "NetC14", "SPD"),
    start = start,
    n_years = n_years,
    n_samples = n_samples[i],
    n_clusters = n_clusters,
    elapsed = elapsed
  )
})

# close parallel processes and collect results
stopCluster(clusters)
timing_results <- do.call(rbind, timing_results)
```

Save results.

```{r}
#| label: save-timings
write.csv(
  timing_results,
  "data/timing-results.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

## Results

```{r}
#| label: plot-elapsed
#| code-fold: true
#| output: false
svglite(
  filename = "figures/evaluate-timing.svg",
  width = 5.5,
  height = 3
)

xy <- aggregate(
  elapsed ~ model + n_samples,
  FUN = median,
  data = timing_results
)

xlim <- range(xy[["n_samples"]])
ylim <- range(xy[["elapsed"]])

layout(matrix(c(1, 0, 2), ncol = 3), widths = c(1, 0.01, 0.23))

par(defaults)
par(mai = c(0.5, 0.5, 0, 0))

new_plot(xlim, ylim)
add_grid()

for (mdl in unique(xy[["model"]])) {
  i <- which(xy[["model"]] == mdl)
  x <- xy[["n_samples"]][i]
  y <- xy[["elapsed"]][i]
  z <- xy[["n_samples"]][i]

  clr <- theme(mdl)
  cbg <- if (mdl == "SPD") "#FFFFFF" else theme(mdl, shade = -0.6)

  lines(x, y, col = clr, lwd = 0.5)
  points(x, y, pch = 21, col = clr, bg = cbg, cex = 1)
}

x_axis()
y_axis()

x_title("N SAMPLES")
y_title("ELAPSED [s]")

par(mai = rep(0, 4))
new_plot(c(0, 1), c(0, 1))
add_legend(
  x = 0,
  y = 0.8,
  legend = c("BGMM", "CKDE", "DPMM", "NetC14", "SPD"),
  pt.bg = c(theme("BGMM", "CKDE", "DPMM", "NetC14", shade = -0.6), "#FFFFFF"),
  col = theme("BGMM", "CKDE", "DPMM", "NetC14", "SPD"),
  text.col = theme("BGMM", "CKDE", "DPMM", "NetC14", "SPD"),
  pch = 21,
  pt.cex = 1.1,
  lwd = 0.5
)

dev.off()
```
